# Cedarwood Studio

> Three fixed-price services: a Rails Upgrade Roadmap and a Node.js Upgrade Roadmap, which show what a Rails or Node.js upgrade breaks before you commit to it ($2,500 each), and a CI Diagnostic, which shows why a GitHub Actions pipeline is slow or flaky and what to change first ($500). The measured pages below draw on public sample repositories that can be checked line by line.

Cedarwood Studio is the business name of Jack Senechal, a sole proprietor. Contact: hello@cedarwood.studio. Prices are in US dollars and are fixed. Each page below carries the date it was last updated.

## Services

- [Rails Upgrade Roadmap, $2,500 fixed](https://cedarwood.studio/rails-upgrade-roadmap/): A fixed-price assessment of a Rails application's upgrade. The first version step is run in a sandbox, and the report says what breaks, with the file and line, including breaks the tests can't see. The deliverable is a reviewed report plus a staged plan with an effort range. Credited toward an upgrade started with the studio; the upgrade itself is quoted separately. Fits Rails apps on 7.0 or later, going to 8.1 or earlier, with a test suite that runs without production secrets and uses MariaDB and Redis at most. Suites that need PostgreSQL, a private gem source or a browser aren't covered. Node.js applications have their own page, the Node.js Upgrade Roadmap, at https://cedarwood.studio/nodejs-upgrade-roadmap/. Delivered within 5 business days of payment and access. Last updated 2026-11-18.
- [Node.js Upgrade Roadmap, $2,500 fixed](https://cedarwood.studio/nodejs-upgrade-roadmap/): A fixed-price assessment of a Node.js application's upgrade. The first version step is run in a sandbox, and the report says what breaks, with the file and line, including breaks the tests can't see. The deliverable is a reviewed report plus a staged plan with an effort range. Credited toward an upgrade started with the studio; the upgrade itself is quoted separately. Fits Node.js applications on 16 or later, going to 26 or earlier, installed with npm, Yarn or pnpm, with a test suite on Mocha, Jest, Vitest, AVA or node:test that runs without production secrets and uses MariaDB and Redis at most. Suites that need PostgreSQL, a private package registry or a browser aren't covered, and neither are framework, bundler or ORM upgrades such as Next.js, NestJS or Nuxt. Delivered within 5 business days of payment and access. Last updated 2026-11-18.
- [CI Diagnostic, $500 fixed](https://cedarwood.studio/github-actions-ci-diagnostic/): A fixed-price diagnostic of a slow or flaky GitHub Actions pipeline, measured from its own run history. A written report of where the time goes, which jobs fail and then pass on re-run, and the changes that give the most back, with the data behind each number. For GitHub Actions. Failing tests are named for pytest and unittest; with other test runners the report works at the level of jobs and steps. Delivered within 3 business days of payment and access. Last updated 2026-11-18.

## Measured answers

- [What breaks when upgrading Rails 7.1 to 8, and how long does each stage take?](https://cedarwood.studio/rails-7-1-to-8-upgrade-what-broke/): One measured upgrade of an open-source Rails application (Postal, about 27,000 lines, 851 test examples) from Rails 7.1.6 to 8.0.5.2: the eight lines flagged as breaking on the path to 8.1, what caught each one, what changed without breaking anything, the review rounds and fixes each stage took, and what a side-by-side browser comparison of 118 screen states showed. Last updated 2026-11-18.
- [Can an AI agent do a Rails upgrade?](https://cedarwood.studio/can-an-ai-agent-do-a-rails-upgrade/): A measured test, with figures, on an unsolicited open-source sample. An automated first pass at a Rails 7.1 to 8 upgrade of a 27,000-line application found 4 of 8 lines flagged as breaking and shipped a stage that passed every check and didn't start with one optional feature on. What a separate review caught, and four questions to ask of any upgrade before trusting it. Last updated 2026-11-18.

## Public samples

- [cedarwood-studio/upgrade-roadmap-sample](https://github.com/cedarwood-studio/upgrade-roadmap-sample): one complete Upgrade Roadmap for Postal, an open-source Rails application (Rails 7.1 to 8.1), the record of the first four stages carried out on a fork, and a script that checks the report against its data. An unsolicited sample: nobody at the Postal project asked for it, and the studio is not affiliated with the project.
- [cedarwood-studio/ci-diagnostic-sample](https://github.com/cedarwood-studio/ci-diagnostic-sample): two complete CI Diagnostic reports on open-source projects (wagtail/wagtail and temporalio/sdk-python), with the data behind every number. Unsolicited samples, not affiliated with either project.
